locked_models.model: LogisticRegression L2 C=1 lbfgs max_iter=2000; training-only geographic standardization
locked_models.metric: M1 minus M0 held-out average log-likelihood in nats per individual

randomized_group_shuffle.inference: All random splits reuse the same plants; these are descriptive partition-stability diagnostics. Percentiles are NOT a sampling-confidence interval and 83/100 is NOT a p value.

outcome_interpretation: The frozen 5-fold negative M1-M0 fitness prediction remains the primary result. Direction is usually negative but can turn positive for some training/test population assignments. No new independent garden/lineage replication or MLTR exact action-conditioned law is established.
constraints: Only original 470 observations, not a new cohort
All comparisons use identical model and features without outcome-driven tuning
Repeated holdouts overlap; no independent replicates
The original paper already reports haploblock genotype-fitness associations
No raw genotypes or specimen IDs are redistributed
